name: Colt McCrae
profile: High-energy showman whose personality and unmistakable patriotic stage look became part of the band's identity.
visualIdentity: American flag bandana, American flag cape, dramatic handlebar mustache, short dark hair with volume, black T-shirt, dark jeans, and decorative cowboy boots.
bio: Colt “Buckshot” McCrae met Tucker and David in middle school. He quickly became part of their circle and their garage-based musical sanctuary. Colt brought raw energy, humor, heart, and a larger-than-life personality to the group. His American flag cape began as a Fourth of July performance idea and became a defining part of his stage wardrobe after the crowd went wild for it.
